column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the utterance of the LORD” is rendered “The LORD said,” and “my lord” is capitalized “my Lord.”
Close to the Hebrew; נְדָבֹת (“freewill offerings”) is rendered “volunteers,” “majesties of holiness” “the beauties of holiness,” and “dawn” “the morning.”
Close to the Hebrew; עַל־ דִּבְרָתִי (“after the manner”) is rendered “According to the order of.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָחַץ (“shatters”) is rendered “He shall execute.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it is full of corpses” is rendered “He shall fill the places with dead bodies,” and “the head over the great earth” “the heads of many countries.”
